headline: Binance reopened withdrawals for 51 more tokens today but has spent half its emergency bitcoin fund, while bitcoin funds kept losing money and Americans vote in the midterms.

market.asOf: BTC read from crypto.news at 06:40 UTC Tue 3 Nov (13:40 Bangkok); ETH and SOL could not be read from a price page this run. Use the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 26 (Fear), down from 37 the day before, on the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index, per CoinGabbar (Tue 3 Nov)

stories.title: Binance reopens 51 more tokens, but its emergency fund is half spent
stories.summary: Binance's second withdrawal phase began at 04:00 UTC today, bringing back 51 tokens on Ethereum and Solana, with more networks still to come. On-chain data shows it spent half the bitcoin in its SAFU user-protection fund to cover the hack, and it has given no date to refill it. The next reserve snapshot is Wednesday.
points: Restored today: 31 more Ethereum tokens and 20 Solana tokens, including LINK, SHIB, ONDO, BONK and TRUMP, after an earlier update brought back five Ethereum stablecoins, per crypto.news.
Still to come: BNB Chain, XRP Ledger, Sui, Arbitrum, Optimism, Tron and Base, per crypto.news.
The SAFU wallet holds just over 7,500 BTC (about $580M), down from 15,000 BTC, after four transactions on 31 Oct, per CoinDesk.
Binance says about 95% of hacked assets have been replaced; the next proof-of-reserves snapshot is 4 Nov, with about 40-50 hours to produce the proof, per crypto.news.
DefiLlama's 24-hour net outflow fell to about $3.5B from an intraday peak of about $7B, per PANews (2 Nov).

stories.title: Bitcoin funds lose money for a second day as a chip-stock rout drags crypto
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds had about $399M of net outflows on Monday after $643M on Friday, and ether funds lost $140M. Bitcoin slipped below $77,000 in Asian trading as a sell-off in chip stocks deepened.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs: about -$398.6M on 2 Nov, with BlackRock's IBIT at -$405M and Fidelity's FBTC at +$6.68M, per SoSoValue data via KuCoin.
Ether ETFs lost about $140M, making about $539M combined with bitcoin, per KuCoin and crypto.news.
Bitcoin was $76,455.56 at 06:40 UTC, down 2.19% in 24 hours, per crypto.news, with nearly $100M of mostly long positions liquidated per CoinGlass.
The US chip index is down 12% in three days and the Nasdaq 100 is about 10% off its peak, per CoinDesk.
Morgan Stanley cut Coinbase to underweight with a $120 price target, down from $258, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Americans vote in the midterms today after record crypto spending
stories.summary: Control of Congress is decided today. The three biggest crypto super PACs spent nearly $170M, mostly backing Republicans. First results are expected as Asian markets open on Wednesday.
points: The three leading crypto super PACs spent nearly $170M; Fairshake spent about $154M and keeps a $56M reserve, per CoinDesk.
Fairshake committed about $56M to defeating Sherrod Brown in Ohio, per CoinDesk.
Kalshi markets gave about a 70% chance of Democrats winning both chambers, per CoinDesk.
Future crypto bills will need Democratic votes to clear the Senate's 60-vote bar after the CLARITY Act stalled, per CoinDesk.
First polls close at 6:00pm ET (06:00 Wed Bangkok) and the last, in Alaska, at 1:00am ET (13:00 Wed Bangkok), per 270toWin.

briefs.title: Arbitrum council moves $30M of hack funds
briefs.summary: Arbitrum's 12-member Security Council used emergency powers to move about 8,425 ETH and 74M ARB (about $30M) from an address tied to the Binance exploit, without the hacker's key, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: OKX gains most from Binance outflows
briefs.summary: OKX took about $445M of 24-hour net inflows, followed by Bybit at $112M, per Cointelegraph citing DefiLlama.

briefs.title: Record month of ether ETF outflows
briefs.summary: Ether ETFs lost $1.61B in October, a monthly record, and bitcoin ETFs lost $515M, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Strategy adds 810 BTC
briefs.summary: Strategy now holds 849,327 BTC, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Brazil's crypto licence deadline nears
briefs.summary: About 40 crypto firms have applied, against 150 to 200 expected, and unlicensed providers must stop by 29 Nov, per CoinGabbar.

briefs.title: Akash votes to move from Cosmos to Solana
briefs.summary: Proposal 346 passed with about 97.27% support; AKT will swap 1:1 for two years after an audit, per CoinGabbar.

briefs.title: NEAR holders vote to cut inflation
briefs.summary: Maximum yearly issuance would fall from 2.5% to 1.6% over 24 months, pending review, per CoinGabbar.
